key_insight: qReduMIS combines QAOA measurements with classical graph reductions to solve portfolio-selection MIS instances more effectively than standalone QAOA.
engineering_relevance: The pipeline shows how near-term quantum hardware can be embedded as a subroutine in a larger optimization workflow for practical financial decision-making.
method: Build a correlation graph from market assets and cast portfolio diversification as a Maximum Independent Set problem.
Run QAOA on graph kernels to identify likely-in-solution “frozen” nodes.
Use those measurements to trigger recursive classical reductions, then solve the reduced graph optimally.
evidence_signal: Validated on real market data from four major indices up to 225 assets, including trapped-ion hardware runs on Quantinuum’s 98-qubit Helios system and emulator benchmarks over 73 graphs.
watch_item: Performance depends on QAOA quality and hardware-induced noise, so the freezing-and-reduction pipeline may be less reliable on harder graphs or deeper circuits.
paper_title: Quantum-Informed Portfolio Selection: An End-to-End Pipeline Validated on Trapped-Ion Hardware with Real Market Data
